flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi: framework/workflows/agencies/toppan/upload/{jobs/ToppanLettersGeneratorJob, jobs/ToppanUploadJob, helpers/ToppanUploadHelper, models/ToppanStage}, framework/services/agencyFileExchange/AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl, framework/services/comcryptSftpBlob/helper/ComcryptUploadProcessor, crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository (findToppanNoticesForStage), resources/{application-{dev,uat,prod}.properties, cron-schedules-prod.properties}. Other repos: not used. The stale copy ocmsadminprivateapi/cronservice/ is not used as evidence.
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%); demo_remark: SFTP Code Split, SFTP permission is granted to the App Service. There is no flow deck. The Toppan Upload (Generate letters) cron runs at 00:15 and processes stages RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3, ANL in order (cron-schedules-prod.properties:61-62). For RD2 the code selects notices that are due, not suspended and have a letter address (letter_address='Y'), builds a 719-character fixed-width data file named URA-DPT-RD2-D1-<timestamp>, uploads it to Azure Blob, then asks COMCRYPT to encrypt it and upload it to the Toppan SFTP. Main gap: sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan in dev, UAT and prod (application-prod.properties:86), so the upload to the vendor is blocked; the delivery gate is deliberately bypassed when blocked so the notice stage still advances to RR3 although the file never reaches the vendor (ToppanUploadJob.java:424-444). That means that in the repo configuration the 2nd letter is not actually sent to the vendor but the notice is recorded as processed. OCMS does not build a PDF for RD2 (PDFs only for ANL); the story allows PDF or data file, and a data file is what is built. Layout conformity with the Toppan specification, receipt at the vendor and the SFTP permission cannot be verified from repo. Tickets: OCMS-DF-2026-170 (properties comment: block Toppan upload), OCMS-DF-2026-192 (Ready to UAT: cron failed 'SFTP FAILED' before the bypass was fixed).
recommendation: Claim partially. Building the RD2 data file is complete, but delivery to the vendor is blocked in the dev/UAT/prod properties and the stage still advances without delivery. Ask for proof that an RD2 file really arrives on the Toppan SFTP in PRD before claiming in full.

steps.step: OCMS selects notices due for the 2nd letter (stage RD2), not suspended, belonging to the current offender
steps.detail: ToppanLettersGeneratorJob processes all ToppanStage values in order, including RD2 (ToppanLettersGeneratorJob.java:151), and each stage calls getValidOffenceNoticesOptimized (ToppanUploadJob.java:248; ToppanUploadHelper.java:1887) which uses findToppanNoticesForStage: next_processing_stage = :stage, next_processing_date <= today, suspension_type IS NULL, an_flag not 'Y', and a join to owner_driver with offender_indicator = 'Y' (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:583-614). The cron runs at 00:15 and is enabled=true in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:61-62). The query does not distinguish owner/hirer/driver (owner_driver_indicator is not filtered), so RD2 applies to whoever is the offender; for the vehicle owner this matches the story. Double check: the 00:15 schedule (process_dayend_jobs) exists and is enabled, but the call to toppanLettersGeneratorService.executeJob() in ToppanUploadJobsScheduler.executeDayEndJobs (line 119) is commented out, so letter generation only runs through the manual trigger POST /toppan/generate-letters. Rated Partial.

steps.step: The letter uses the owner's updated address; notices without a letter address are not included
steps.detail: Addresses are enriched from ONOD_addr (enrichNoticesWithAddressesOptimized, ToppanUploadHelper.java:2151-2160), notices with no address field at all are dropped (F-17, ToppanUploadHelper.java:2026-2047), then filterByLetterAddress only lets through notices that have an address with letter_address='Y' (ToppanUploadHelper.java:2372-2400; called at ToppanUploadJob.java:266-275). The mha_reg address from the MHA result is written to the same address record (bufferMhaRegistrationAddress, MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:2280-2290), so the latest address from the check is used when it arrived before the letter is built. Notices without a letter address are not sent and stay at stage RD2 until an address exists.

steps.step: OCMS builds the 2nd letter data file for the vendor to print and post
steps.detail: File name URA-DPT-RD2-D1-<yyyyMMddHHmmss> (ToppanUploadJob.java:278-282), content built by createRequestFileContent('TOPPAN_RD2') (ToppanUploadJob.java:286-292; AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:79-88): a 719-character fixed-width file with header H, one detail line per notice (sorted by postal code) and trailer T with the record count (AgencyFileExchangeServiceImpl.java:564-612). The original file is uploaded to Azure Blob (ToppanUploadJob.java:308-318). OCMS does not build a PDF for RD2 (PDFs are only built for stage ANL, ToppanUploadJob.java:324-339); the story allows PDF or data file, so the data file satisfies it. The layout against the Toppan specification and the letter the vendor prints cannot be verified from repo.

steps.step: OCMS sends that file to the vendor (Toppan) over SFTP
steps.detail: The code requests a COMCRYPT token for encryption (ToppanUploadJob.java:347-356) and the callback uploads the encrypted file to the Toppan SFTP; the stage only advances once delivery is confirmed. But sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan in prod, UAT and dev (application-prod.properties:84-86; application-uat.properties:77; application-dev.properties:77), and ComcryptUploadProcessor throws SftpDisabledException for a blocked server (ComcryptUploadProcessor.java:203-216). So the file is not delivered to the vendor. After that the delivery gate is deliberately bypassed when upload is blocked (gateBypassed, ToppanUploadJob.java:419-430), so updateProcessingStage still advances the notice from RD2 to RR3 (ToppanUploadJob.java:444). So in the repo configuration the notice is recorded as sent although the file never reaches the vendor. Tickets OCMS-DF-2026-170 (Toppan upload block) and OCMS-DF-2026-192 (cron failed 'SFTP FAILED', Ready to UAT). Receipt on the Toppan SFTP, the SFTP permission of the App Service and the real per-environment property value cannot be verified from repo.
